Name: Jonathan, Son of Gershom
Summary: Jonathan, son of Gershom, was the young Levite from Bethlehemjudah who became Micah's priest and then priest to the tribe of Dan, serving until the captivity. Judges 18:30 gives his line as 'son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh' in the KJV reading.
KeyStory: A young Levite wandering from Bethlehemjudah was hired by Micah for ten shekels a year, then went with the Danites to Laish, where he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the captivity.
LifeLesson: A priest for hire will serve whoever carries him off.
